name: 5th Street Commons
summary: 5th Street Commons is a contemporary mixed-use development on West 5th Street in Austin, combining residential living with retail and service amenities. Located in a prime urban corridor just west of downtown, it serves as a convenient community hub for the surrounding neighborhood.
demographics: 5th Street Commons primarily serves young urban professionals and students in the West Austin area, with a strong concentration of millennials and Gen Z residents aged 22-40. The trade area attracts middle to upper-middle income households drawn to the vibrant West 5th Street corridor, known for its walkable urban lifestyle and proximity to downtown Austin. Visitors typically seek convenient residential amenities and services within a mixed-use environment that blends retail, dining, and apartment living.
description: 5th Street Commons is a modern mixed-use development located at 1611 West 5th Street in the heart of Austin's desirable West 5th Street corridor. This contemporary community center seamlessly integrates residential living with retail and service amenities, creating a vibrant urban destination for Austin residents and visitors. The property embodies the live-work-play lifestyle that has become synonymous with Austin's dynamic urban growth, offering convenient access to downtown while maintaining a neighborhood feel. With its prime location just west of downtown Austin, 5th Street Commons serves as a hub for the surrounding residential community, providing essential services and retail options within walking distance. The center has earned a solid 4.1-star rating from 43 reviews, reflecting its role as a valued community asset in one of Austin's most sought-after neighborhoods.
